svg.title: SECTOR-9 — VECTOR SIEGE (Third Person)
svg.desc: Merged pure-SVG 3D third-person shooter. HEXFIELD soldier rig + CITY ASSAULT waves, large robots, drones, companion soldier, lock-on targeting, VFX, minimap, oscilloscope.

g.text: STANCE HIP | GAIT AUTO | FREE AIM
[WASD] MOVE [SHIFT] SPRINT [LMB] FIRE [RMB] ADS [R] RELOAD [Q] LOCK [E] CYCLE [F] SNAP [O] OSC [ ] SCOPE PTS [1-4/T] GAIT [WHEEL] ZOOM
THIRD PERSON COMBAT — MERGED FPS + RIG PROTOCOL — PURE SVG 3D
36-BOX OPERATIVE + VIPER-2 WINGMAN vs LARGE ROBOTS + BOMBER DRONES — 10 WAVES
LMB (HOLD) ...... FIRE RMB (HOLD) ....... AIM DOWN SIGHTS
E ............... CYCLE TARGET F ................ SNAP CAMERA
LB .............. CYCLE GAIT RB ............... CYCLE TARGET
- LARGE ROBOTS: 140 HP, patrol / chase / attack, heavy shots. Aim for the core.
- BOMBER DRONES: 60 HP, fly low / high / loiter, drop blast waves — keep moving.
- VIPER-2 follows you and auto-engages the nearest hostile. Protect the wingman.
- GREEN CRYSTALS +36 RESERVE AMMO — PURPLE CRYSTALS +40 INTEGRITY.
- Q locks the nearest hostile in a 24 deg cone; camera soft-tracks while locked.
- Waves tint hostiles GREEN > YELLOW > RED. Clear wave 10 to liberate the sector.
PAINTER'S ALGORITHM - BACKFACE CULLING - PERSPECTIVE PROJECTION - RAY/SPHERE + RAY/BOX HITSCAN
ALL RENDERED EDGES STREAM AS X/Y TO WEB AUDIO STEREO — CONNECT L/R TO AN OSCILLOSCOPE
